subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Anxiety
solution:
The correct answer is **"Relief".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Words with **opposite meanings** are said to be **antonyms.**
 
• The **emotion of anxiety **is one of **fear, dread, and unease.**
 
• **Relief **is a state of contentment that **something unpleasant has passed or stopped.**
 
• So, both meanings are **opposite to each other.​​​​​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The meaning of the **rest three options **are given below:
 
• **Discomfort:** **Discomfort **is defined as a **feeling of mental or bodily discomfort**.
 
• **Agitation: **The act of **agitating something**,** or an instance of it**, is what the word **"agitation"** means.
 
• **Stress:** **Stress** is characterized as a condition of **anxiety or mental tension brought on by a challenging circumstance**.
 
• These three are not the **opposite **of the word **"Anxiety"**.
